[today] Sign accuracy 48.3% over 89 directional calls is not statistically different from a coin flip (p=0.750).
[today] 92% of predictions were NEUTRAL (smaller than the neutral band); directional accuracy counts them wrong whenever the actual move leaves the band, so read sign accuracy for the UP/DOWN calls.
86.1% of predictions had no NEW company news since the previous cut-off; with relative sentiment those carry no company-news signal.

News availability: 0 of 16253 articles in the period (0.0%) were demonstrably collected before the cut-off they could be used for. The rest rely on provider timestamps of retrospectively collected news - this backtest is NOT equivalent to a live-news backtest.
93.5% of news was collected after the fact (backfill). Backfilled feeds can omit since-deleted articles (survivorship) - live-collected news is the gold standard for backtests.
Historical performance does not guarantee future performance.
